description.additional-info: For example allergens, ingredients, or notes. Customers can view this through the information icon.
description.invite: Send this link to the person. They use it to set up their passkey (valid for 7 days, single use).
description.confirm-delete-item: "{{name}}" will be deleted. Existing orders stay unchanged. Tip: prefer deactivating items.
description.confirm-delete-category: "{{name}}" will be deleted. Its items are kept.
description.confirm-delete-account: "{{name}}" will no longer be able to sign in.
description.schedule: Pickup days are generated from this rule. Individual days can deviate from it below.
description.deadline-offset: 1 means the deadline is the day before pickup. 0 means the pickup day itself.
description.upcoming-pickup-days: Past its deadline a day is frozen: no new orders, no cancellations, no changes.
description.move-pickup-day: Existing orders move to the new date with it.
description.close-pickup-day: A called-off day takes no orders, the shop moves on to the next one.
description.close-cancels-orders_one: Careful: {{count}} order will be cancelled and its customer informed by mail.
description.close-cancels-orders_other: Careful: {{count}} orders will be cancelled and their customers informed by mail.
description.confirm-lock-day_one: The day becomes binding immediately. {{count}} customer gets the confirmation mail, no new orders afterwards.
description.confirm-lock-day_other: The day becomes binding immediately. {{count}} customers get the confirmation mail, no new orders afterwards.
description.legal: Both links appear in the public shop footer. Leaving one empty hides it — for a public shop both are mandatory though.
description.imprint-url: Full address including https://, for example the association’s imprint page.
description.privacy-url: The privacy policy has to describe what this shop does with the order data.
